sources.snippet: Moondream2 is an open-source, compact vision-language model designed for low-resource environments. With 1.86 billion parameters, it offers a balance between efficiency and performance, making it suitable for various vision-language tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, visual knowledge reasoning, visual commonsense reasoning, and text recognition.
